text:
mira: Quick pop quiz: rooftop yoga (20 min) at 12:20 then hill-sprint ladder at 1pm? Mat and shoes swap in the common room. :woman_in_lotus_position: :athletic_shoe:

sam: I'm in for yoga but need to duck at 12:45 for a call. Can I join sprints later?

mira: Yup! plan is modular. Yoga 12:20-12:40, chill cooldown then sprints at 13:00. You can join the ladder set at 13:15 no prob.

raj: How many rounds for the ladder? And is it OK if I bring a kettlebell for extra fun? :kettlebell:

emma: Ladder idea: 30s sprint, 60s walk x3 rounds. Light KB swings after if people want. Need to keep it short so folks can get back.

dave: What about parking or bike storage? I'm biking and don't want to leave it in the lobby.

mira: Bike storage is fine, rack code is 2206. Security said it's OK for quick sessions.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Rooftop Yoga + Hill Ladder" Tomorrow 12:20-13:30. Invite sent to #lunch-plans.

strava-bot: If you want to track sprints, start a manual activity and tag it "Redwood Hill Ladder".

sam: Quick poll: react with :woman_in_lotus_position: for yoga+ladder, :runner: for ladder-only, :pray: to skip but cheer. I'll tally at 11:50.

emma: :woman_in_lotus_position:

raj: :runner:

dave: :woman_in_lotus_position:

mira: :woman_in_lotus_position:

sam: Nice, looks like a yoga-heavy turnout. Bring a towel for the rooftop (it's sunny).

emma: Also bringing a tiny foam roller for post-sprint calves. No sharps, just foam.

dave: I'll bring protein bars (contains nuts)  anyone allergic?

raj: nut allergy here. can we do one nut-free pack pls?

dave: yes will label and leave nut-free box on the bench.

mira: safety note: rooftop is tile near the planter. please remove shoes and use mats only. no heavy KBs on tiles (we'll move KBs to the grass patch).

sam: also reminder to stash valuables in lockers; security gave temporary code 6701 for today.

emma: tiny brag: did 10 mins of balance drills this morning, felt way better in the hip flexors. hope to not faceplant during tree pose. :sweat_smile:

raj: tree pose is overrated until you lock it in. see you all tomorrow!

mira: See you — photos encouraged but keep it PG-13. :camera_with_flash:

calendar-bot: Reminder set: 11:50 to post session ping in #lunch-plans.

sam: pumped. whoever forgets a mat owes coffee. :coffee:

emma: deal.
